color-system.twistDescription: No twist applied — copied verbatim as specified. pageBackground #ffffff luminance=255 (>190, qualifies for light register).

type-system.twistDescription: Twist B: Letter spacing injection — added --font-letter-spacing-heading: 0.06em applied to all heading levels. Font replacements: NotionInter→Inter (Google Fonts CDN), Lyon Text→Instrument Serif (Google Fonts CDN), iA Writer Mono→JetBrains Mono (Google Fonts CDN), Permanent Marker kept (already Google Fonts).

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Duration scaling ×1.5 (slower). All transition durations scaled: 0.6s→0.9s, 0.2s→0.3s, 0.5s→0.75s, 0.1s→0.15s, 0.3s→0.45s. Produces a more languid, measured pacing across all content reveals and micro-interactions.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist B: Gap value compression ×0.85. Column gaps compressed from 34.56px→29.376px, 69.12px→58.752px. Tighter editorial rhythm reinforcing the precision-minimalist aesthetic.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist C: Hero padding emphasis ×1.5. Hero section padding scaled from 96px→144px (top and bottom). All other spacing values unchanged.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist E: Focus state enhancement. Added outlineWidth: 2px and outlineOffset: 2px to all focus states (buttons, inputs, links, nav links, cards). No color values modified.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist D: Letter spacing on nav links — set typography.letterSpacing to 0.08em. Reinforces the tracked heading aesthetic from the type system across the navigation layer.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist C: Material shift — added specific physical materiality detail to the grid spacing paragraph: gutters described as 'precision of a scored crystal face... as exact as the clearance machined into a precision bearing race.' Generated concept_by_video.md with 3 video placements: hero-surface.mp4, work-ambient.mp4, editorial-detail.mp4.
